opening_debt.note: The notes and aircraft certificates carrying amount is consolidated debt less the disclosed finance lease liability. The 3.75% is the reported annualized weighted-average interest rate on the opening long-term debt excluding finance leases. The filing does not disaggregate current versus noncurrent finance leases.

note_principal_basis.status: contractual face payments reconstructed from filed terms at constant FX

aircraft_certificates.note: Prospectus schedule continues at this amount per distribution through August 2033. The expected principal after August 2026 agrees with the $659 million balance at the precision reported in the September 10-Q.

note_principal_basis.note: The calendar schedule combines remaining senior note series and aircraft certificate amortization. July tender reductions and September issuance are already in September debt. The schedule uses stated maturities and excludes optional early redemption and refinancing. The January 2027 EUR notes became callable in October, but remained listed in the November 9 Form 8-K and no exercise was identified by the cutoff. Dollar amounts may vary from future cash settlement and carrying amounts because of exchange rates, hedges and amortized discounts or issuance costs. The 2032 bucket supports year-end 2031 current classification.

finance_lease_basis.note: September Note 10 gives payments through 2030 and $610 million aggregate from 2031 onward. The $110 million calendar 2031 proxy is the May 10-K amount for the legacy fiscal year ending May 31, 2031. Different reporting dates and contract populations make it an estimate. It is included in the $610 million aggregate. The May 31 weighted-average discount rate of 4.06% is used as a proxy to split gross payments into interest and principal. September payment dates and the post-2030 breakdown were not disclosed.

dividends.note: The October payment amount uses the September equity statement's $290 million declaration, tied to the October 1 payment by Note 1. Release the opening dividend payable and record the October financing cash outflow without a second reduction in retained earnings. No subsequent declaration was identified by the November 12 cutoff. The model estimates a separate Q4 declaration payable in the following quarter using $1.22 times the latest disclosed share count. The annualized $4.88 per share is a flat-rate planning assumption, subject to future board approval.

treasury_stock.note: The treasury stock roll-forward is measured at accounting cost. The equity statement's buyback entry and option-exercise line differ from the cash flow statement's repurchases and issuance proceeds. The unspent board authorization is discretionary. Historical stock proceeds and repurchases do not prescribe a future amount.

funding_assumptions.note: Analyst baseline pays existing scheduled note and finance lease principal out of available funds. The zeros represent a forecast choice because no quantified post-September new notes, lease replacement, stock issuance or buyback program execution schedule was identified by the cutoff. Update the assumptions when commitments or scenario inputs are available.
